prompt: Build a SaaS landing page for Atlas AI Consulting
decomposition: 1. Add a hero section with a strong CTA.
2. Add a menu/navbar with the site title.
3. Add three feature cards for strategy, implementation, and training.
4. Add a 3-tier pricing section (Starter, Growth, Enterprise).
5. Add a customer logos bar with at least 5 logos.
6. Add three testimonials.
7. Add a closing CTA 'Book a discovery call' via a contact section.
8. Update site metadata for Atlas AI Consulting.
personaMessage: Your Atlas AI Consulting landing page is ready, complete with hero, features, pricing, and contact.

props.text: Atlas AI: Guiding Your Digital Transformation
Unlock unprecedented growth and efficiency with expert AI strategy and implementation.

props.title: AI Strategy & Roadmap
props.hook: Define a clear path to AI success tailored to your business goals.
props.problem: Many businesses struggle to identify impactful AI applications and a coherent strategy.
props.resolution: We help you pinpoint opportunities, assess readiness, and build a phased roadmap for sustainable AI integration.

props.title: Seamless AI Implementation
props.hook: Bring your AI vision to life with expert development and deployment.
props.problem: Implementing AI solutions can be complex, requiring specialized skills and robust infrastructure.
props.resolution: Our team handles everything from model development to system integration, ensuring smooth and effective deployment.

props.title: Empowering AI Training
props.hook: Equip your team with the knowledge and skills to master AI technologies.
props.problem: Adopting AI requires a skilled workforce, often leading to internal knowledge gaps.
props.resolution: We provide customized training programs and workshops to empower your employees to confidently leverage AI tools and strategies.

content.heading: Our Core Services
content.subheading: Guiding your journey from concept to AI-driven reality.

content.heading: Flexible Pricing for Every Scale
content.subheading: Choose the plan that fits your ambition.
